# eee

Encrypted P2P chat + file sharing. Zero servers, zero accounts, zero dependencies.

<!-- Demo GIF (generated by release.sh via VHS) -->
![demo](https://github.com/wildneuro/eee-chat/releases/latest/download/demo.gif)

## Features

- **End-to-end encrypted** — AES-256-GCM, session key derived from shared secret
- **P2P** — libp2p DHT + mDNS + relay + hole-punching, no server needed
- **File sharing** — drag-drop or `/send`, with ASCII image preview before accepting
- **Privacy mode** — messages masked by default, reveal one word at a time
- **Screen recording detection** — detects and kills OBS, Zoom, Teams, QuickTime, etc.
- **Audio notifications** — subtle beep on message send/receive (cross-platform)
- **Auto-update** — checks for new versions on startup, self-updates in-place
- **Dark theme** — clean terminal UI with lipgloss
- **Cross-platform** — macOS, Linux, Windows (amd64 + arm64)
- **Single binary** — no runtime dependencies, ~10MB

## Install

**macOS / Linux / WSL:**
```
curl -sSL https://github.com/wildneuro/eee-chat/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```
iwr -useb https://github.com/wildneuro/eee-chat/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

## Usage

```
eee                        TUI: generate or enter a shared secret key
eee <64hex>                skip key entry, join with a shared key
eee listen                 headless mode (print key + PeerID)
eee connect <PeerID> <key> headless connect
eee remove                 uninstall (removes config + binary)
```

### In TUI chat

```
/send <path>   send a file (or just drag-drop file into terminal)
/accept        accept an incoming file
/decline       decline an incoming file
/preview       preview image before accepting
/privacy       toggle message masking (default on)
/new           new session (new key)
/update        check and apply updates
/help          show available commands
/quit          exit
```

### How it works

1. Run `eee` — a 64-char hex key is generated and copied to clipboard
2. Share the key with someone (any channel — Signal, email, etc.)
3. They run `eee <key>`
4. You're connected — messages and files flow directly, encrypted

Same-LAN peers connect instantly via mDNS. Remote peers connect via
DHT provider records + relay fallback (~30s).

## Build from source

```
make build       # build for current platform
make dist        # build all platforms + archives
./release.sh     # patch bump release (or: minor, major, vX.Y.Z)
```

## Tech

- Go + [bubbletea](https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea) (TUI)
- [libp2p](https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p) (networking)
- AES-256-GCM (encryption)
- Zero external runtime dependencies

## Uninstall

```
eee remove      # self-deletes binary + config
```
